DEVIATIONS: Task file <-> journal task mapping is not in the contract. Implemented: the file stem (the /plan-task id; the template and skill now say so) OR the id leading the title (`# Task: T4 - ...`), compared case-insensitively.

Current milestone for the build exit = the latest `milestone` event's id, else the latest task event's milestone; `checkctl phase-exit --from build --milestone <mid>` overrides. The build exit also finds a done task's file in tasks/archive/ (plan-task archives done files) and runs each distinct Test command once.

Legacy session_start.phase: a lifecycle word (e.g. 'build') still counts until the first `phase` event exists; free text such as 'implementation' reads as unset. `statectl start --phase` stays as a legacy label and cannot move the phase once phase events exist.
Task-file enumeration excludes every `_`-prefixed file (not only _template.md), matching check_task_reality.

Fixed a pre-existing console bug in scope of 'parses under the console reader': the status regex captured the closing italic underscore ('doing_'). The one regex now lives in _lib.TASK_STATUS_LINE_RE, used by consolectl and checkctl.

Doctor: WORK_MODES/LIFECYCLE_PHASES now come from _lib; the mode row accepts full names and input aliases, so test_secrets' 'guided' fixture is unchanged and still OK; 'phases' added to DOCTOR_CONFIGS.

proposal resolve: --note is required (unbracketed in the contract); --kind defaults to feature; resolving an already-resolved proposal records it with STATE_WARN. Store ops: {op:add,id,text,source,kind} and {op:resolve,id,resolution,note}. No proposals.json projection: _lib.proposal_records() folds the jsonl for statectl and the console.
--override is written to the event only when the exit check failed and was overridden; `statectl phase X` while already in X is a no-op.
deploy_drift returns SKIP (not OK) outside an organised deploy phase; untracked files count only when their mtime is after the phase began; the ignore list is a knob (phases.drift_ignore).

Existing tests changed on purpose: test_console's empty-payload freshness expectation (work.proposals is live) and new payload keys; test_statectl MINIMAL_FIELDS gains mode/phase and the verdict-token command list gains the new commands.
Envelope `status` is 'done' (post-write-validate accepts only done|partial|blocked), STATUS is 'ok', as T8 did.
UNCERTAINTIES: Ran on Windows under Git Bash only; the Ubuntu CI lane was not run.
PR-<n> ids are counted from the store (max + 1) as the contract asks; two concurrent `proposal add` calls could mint the same id (needs-human moved to derived ids for exactly that race).
deploy_drift uses `git log --since` (committer dates): a commit made during deploy but carrying an older committer date would be missed.
The badge and the proposals list were verified by payload/template tests and a full consolectl build, not visually in a browser.
Test commands are split with shlex in POSIX mode: a Windows backslash path inside a Test command would be mangled (the skill says to write it for the repo root).
